release_notes:
Fixed a Wise payment-matching bug, added safety confirmations to admin quick actions

Fixed a rare bug where a customer's Wise payment could be credited to a different customer's older, unpaid invoice instead of their own, if both happened to request the same dollar amount. Payments now only auto-credit when the match is certain; anything uncertain is flagged for manual review instead of guessed.

Also added a confirmation step to the admin panel's "Reset Password" and "Reset PIN" quick actions, and made them visually distinct from routine actions like "Login As Client" — reducing the chance of an accidental click, since both email new credentials to the customer immediately.
